Partick Thistle Football Club are a professional football club from Glasgow, Scotland, and currently plays in the Scottish Championship. Despite their name, the club are based at Firhill Stadium in the Maryhill area of the city, and have not played in Partick since 1908. The club have been members of the Scottish Professional Football League (SPFL) since its formation in 2013, having previously been members of the Scottish Football League.
